Definition: Massah, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Massah was the place in the wilderness where Israel tempted the LORD, asking whether He was among them or not, and Moses called its name Massah, testing, and Meribah, chiding, because of the chiding of the children of Israel. Moses warns the people never to tempt the LORD their God as they tempted Him in Massah, and Levi's blessing remembers that God proved His holy one at Massah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Massah is the name of every place we demand proof from God instead of trusting Him, and the rock that gave water there still cries against us.
RelatedEvents: Water from the Rock at Meribah
